text: EventUtils annotates aEvent.type and aEvent.code as integers, while its implementation compares type to keydown/keyup strings and passes code into the event dictionary with an empty-string default. Recommend documenting those options with their real string contracts when editing this helper. The accepted JSDoc syntax is not proof of semantic type correctness; no keyboard event or text-input processor was executed. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations.
